facts.claim: No official ПДП, генплан sheet or akimat document was found that assigns a land use to the plot south of TARIH's southern street (south of пр. Улы Дала, west end). Searches of ecoportal.kz, gov.kz/astana and news sites returned only documents for the NORTH side of Улы Дала.

Krisha's UIA.TARIH complex page and a TARIH listing both say the complex is located 'next to the city's green belt' (рядом зелёный пояс Астаны). This is the developer's own description, not a planning document.

The capital's tree nursery, run by ТОО 'Астана-Зеленстрой', covers almost 350 ha. No source found says exactly where it is, so it is not confirmed to be the plantation seen on Sentinel south of the cluster.

Krisha has a land listing: 'Участок 1.96 га, Улы дала 2', Нура district, purpose МЖС, price 1,000,000,000 ₸. Its description reads '1 линия, Смежные участки 2 школы, ПДП МЖК 9-12'. This suggests the ПДП allows 9–12-floor housing with 2 school plots somewhere along Улы Дала. The exact location is unknown, and the listing is not tied to TARIH.
The Astana General Plan to 2035 was first approved by Government Resolution No. 33 of 25 January 2024.

The government approved an updated (corrected) General Plan to 2035 by a resolution of 4 August 2026, in force from 8 August 2026. It keeps plots №5, №7 and №9 of the Малый Талдыколь lakes and expands the green belt. It plans 123 schools in phase 1 (to 2030) plus 55 more by 2035. Population targets are 1.97 M (2030) and 2.275 M (2035). No street-level details (Айтматова, Улы Дала) are published in the news summaries.

Kursiv's summary of the approved plan names the Taldykol and Maybalyk lake systems and the green belt as valuable natural areas. It says the published provisions give no detail on further LRT (Tarlan Astana) lines.

Akim Kasymbek gave this split: Big Taldykol = sites 1–2, Малый Талдыколь = sites 3–9. Sites 1, 2, 5, 7 and 9 are preserved. Sites 3, 4, 6 and 8 are designated for development under the general plan. A court decision fixes water-protection zones (500 m zone, 100 m strip for Big Taldykol and site 7), and construction is banned inside them. Eco-park main works are planned for 2026, with some work moving to 2027.

Малый Талдыколь lies around ул. Сыганак, Казыбек би and Розы Багляновой, with its filled-in shore along пр. Улы Дала. Lakes №5 and №7 are designated for an eco-park. Of the original seven lakes, two were filled and now hold a residential complex and two schools. This area is NORTH of Улы Дала, not south of TARIH.

The design for streets 'Эллингтон-1…20' lies 'севернее проспекта Улы Дала, восточнее ул. Ч. Айтматова', near lake Талдыколь and south of Сыганак. Inside its red lines are 'болота от озера малый Талдыколь'. These are district-level main streets connecting to Айтматова and Улы Дала, and the document refers to a ПДП correction. All of this is NORTH of Улы Дала.
The Малый Талдыколь eco-park is to start construction in 2026. The design has 73 wells to keep the water level and a pedestrian bridge over the lake linking two residential districts.
The Taldykol eco-park budget is 4.5 bn ₸, with completion planned for 2027. A natural park of more than 70 ha is announced near Big Taldykol.

The ул. Айтматова section from Сыганак to пр. Улы Дала opened in November 2023 with 4 of 8 lanes. The akimat said the link to Улы Дала and all 8 lanes would follow in 2024. The article says nothing about continuing south of Улы Дала.

Айтматова (Сыганак to Улы Дала) was built as part of the 'малая кольцевая автодорога' project. The akimat describes the small ring road as running along Кошкарбаева, Улы Дала, Акжол and Бейсековой, about 46 km. So the ring runs along Улы Дала itself, and Айтматова ends at it.

The Astana 2026 road-works list covers only landscaping on Айтматова between Улы Дала and Сыганак, plus Мухамедханова from Айтматова to Коргалжынское шоссе. It mentions NO extension of Айтматова south of Улы Дала.
Улы Дала from Айтматова to Толе би was closed for road and construction works from 26 July to 7 August 2025.

Krisha gives UIA.TARIH's address as 'ул. Е 909, 29' and UIA.BIRLIK's as 'ул. Е 908, 23'. Tumar's Uly Dala Park is at 'ул. Е 908, 22'. 'Е-nnn' is Astana's code for designed streets that have no name yet. No document was found that says where Е 909 runs, whether it is built, or where it leads.

BI's official ŪIA page (seen only as a search snippet, because the site returns 403) lists three clusters: DARYN, BIRLIK and TARIH. Planned infrastructure: 2 'Yourt' neighbourhood centres, 2 'Äldi BI' kindergartens and 2 schools, including a 'Физико-математический лицей' and a 'Комфортная школа'.
BI launched ŪIA with a booking start in February 2025, promising 'уютные улицы, школы, детские сады, магазины и зоны отдыха'. No apartment or resident totals were published.

Korter, ŪIA.TARIH (building 4364): comfort+/business+, 9–12 floors, brick, 1,011 apartments of 30–112 m². Queues listed: A (10 sections, start Q4 2025, delivery Q4 2026), В (10 sections, Q4 2026), Е (5 sections, start Q4 2025, delivery Q1 2027), C (10 sections, Q1 2027). No queues D or F are listed.

Krisha, UIA.TARIH: 337 apartments, queue 1 'I кв. 2026' and queue 2 'I кв. 2027'. Shared-construction (БВУ) registrations No. 66 (19.11.2025), No. 23 (27.02.2026) and No. 34 (19.03.2026). The page names Блоки А and И as comfort+ and Блок С as business class.

Korter, ŪIA.DARYN (slug uia-burkit, building 4235, пр. Улы Дала 10): 17 houses, 9–17 floors, 2,137 apartments of 38–119 m². Queues and deliveries: E, K, K-2 Q1 2027; С Q2 2027; D, F, G Q3 2027; A Q4 2027. Starts were Q3–Q4 2025. Construction photo points were updated 2026-08-30.

Krisha, UIA.DARYN (Улы Дала 14): 784 apartments, stages from Q2 2026 to Q3 2027, and БВУ registrations of 04.03.2026 (No. 28, No. 29) and 03.07.2026 (No. 74). The nearest school is listed as 'Комфортная средняя школа №118', 585 m, and a bus stop is 515 m away.

Korter, ŪIA.SŪNQAR (Улы Дала 14): standard class, modular keramzite-concrete, 9–17 floors, 14 sections in 2 queues, both due Q3 2026. Krisha lists 112 apartments, 'IV кв. 2025', and says the developer lacks shared-construction permits (that page may be outdated).

Korter, UIA.BIRLIK ('вдоль пр. Улы дала', centre about 51.1027, 71.3646): 425 apartments, 25 sections, 9/17 floors, 'Площадь застройки 30 Га'. Queues: A Q3 2026; B and D Q4 2026; B-2 Q1 2027; E and F Q2 2027. Krisha names the legal developers as ТОО 'UlyDala Miras' (block A) and ТОО 'Ormanda' (block D), with ТОО 'BI Development Astana' as authorised company. Its last БВУ registration is KZ79PDD00004106 of 28.08.2026.

The vagapov.kz page for UIA BIRLIK-D lists 'РФМШ (физико-математический лицей)' under 'А также ожидается в проекте' (also expected in the project), with no address, date or details. The same page lists the existing private Bibigul Tulegenova Creative School (1,058 pupils) as nearby.
A kn.kz resale ad for Uia.Sunqar (published 03.10.2026) says 'Рядом будет Физико-математическая школа, а через дорогу уже есть лицей'. The physics-math school is described as future, not existing.
РФМШ's Astana branch has operated since 2016 at ул. Туркистан 2/1. No news, government or РФМШ announcement of a second Astana building or of a school in ŪIA was found.

The government allocated 7 bn ₸ from the Special State Fund (returned assets) for a 1,200-place state school in Нура district, under construction with completion by end-2027. It is meant to relieve schools №84, 85, 89 and 97. Its street location is not given and it is not described as a physics-math school.
The Bibigul Tulegenova Creative School, a private school founded by Armanzhan Baitassov, opened in Astana on 1 September 2024. Its street address is not stated in the news found.

New bus route №74 (ЖК Altyn Besik to ЖК Dostar-1) started on 21 February 2026 and runs on 'новым участкам улиц Ш. Айтматова и Улы Дала' and Айтеке би. CTS is the operator. The list of stops was not published.
Routes 15, 15А, 26, 35, 54, 60 and 314 use stops 'ЖК Арнау' and 'ЖК Камал-1' on пр. Улы Дала. These stops are on the eastern, built part of the avenue, not confirmed near the Айтматова junction.
Astana plans 29.7 km of new bus lanes in 2026, including a section of пр. Улы Дала starting from пр. Туран. The end point is cut off in the snippet.

In 2023 akim Kasymbek promised no new construction at Малый Талдыколь. Bes.media reported a residential building going up east of the future park under the 2016 general plan, on land given to АО 'СПК Astana' (2021) and ТОО 'Multipoint.kz' (2022).

result.south_of_tarih: FACTS: No approved ПДП sheet, akimat decision or news item was found that says what will be built south of TARIH's southern street. The only public statements tie the site to the green belt: BI and Krisha describe TARIH as 'next to the city's green belt'. The updated General Plan to 2035 (approved 4 Aug 2026, in force 8 Aug 2026) commits only in general terms to 'expanding the green belt'. One Krisha land ad ('Улы дала 2', 1.96 ha, МЖС, 'ПДП МЖК 9-12, смежные участки 2 школы') shows that 9–12-floor housing plus school plots exist somewhere on the ПДП along Улы Дала, but its exact location is unknown. The Талдыколь redevelopment and eco-park are NOT south of TARIH. Малый Талдыколь (sites 3–9) lies north of Улы Дала, around Сыганак, Казыбек би and Багляновой, east of Айтматова. Sites 5, 7 and 9 are preserved, and 3, 4, 6 and 8 are designated for development. ESTIMATE: the land the user saw empty south of TARIH B is most likely green-belt or nursery land, or an unstarted ПДП housing/school plot. Either way nothing is under construction, and no public timeline exists. For a ground-floor unit in TARIH B, do not count on foot traffic from the south for several years.
result.west_of_aitmatova: FACTS: No planning document or news was found for land WEST of the Айтматова line south of Улы Дала. Every design document found (the Эллингтон-1…20 streets, the Малый Талдыколь eco-park, the BI clusters) lies EAST of Айтматова. The Taldykol lake system is protected by court-set water-protection zones (500 m zone, 100 m strip for Big Taldykol and site 7), and building is banned inside them. Big Taldykol (sites 1–2) is preserved, and a natural park of more than 70 ha is announced near it (4.5 bn ₸, completion targeted for 2027). ESTIMATE: the steppe and wetland west of TARIH sit inside or next to the protected Taldykol and green-belt zones. They are unlikely to be built up in the medium term, so TARIH A/B will stay at the western edge of the city.
result.aitmatova_extension: FACTS: Айтматова runs from Коргалжынское шоссе to Сыганак (opened 2016) and then from Сыганак to пр. Улы Дала (opened November 2023 with 4 lanes; 8 lanes and the Улы Дала link were promised for 2024; landscaping was still under way in June 2026). The street was built under the 'малая кольцевая' project, whose ring itself follows Улы Дала (Кошкарбаева, Улы Дала, Акжол, Бейсековой, about 46 km). The akimat's 2026 road programme mentions only landscaping on Айтматова between Улы Дала and Сыганак and Мухамедханова between Айтматова and Коргалжынское шоссе. No source found announces an extension of Айтматова south of Улы Дала, a date for it, or a destination. ESTIMATE: south of Улы Дала, Айтматова is at most a local access stub along the ÜIA cluster's west edge, not a funded through road. Treat a through road there as unplanned or unfunded.

result.southern_street_e909: FACTS: Krisha gives TARIH's address as 'ул. Е 909, 29' and TARIH listings as 'Е 909 23/29'. BIRLIK (about 1.1 km east) is at 'Е 908, 23', and Tumar's Uly Dala Park at 'Е 908, 22'. 'Е-nnn' codes mark designed streets that have no name yet. checked.evidence: The zakon.kz article (11.08.2026) matches. The agent missed the resolution number: it is No. 697 of 04.08.2026, amending No. 33 of 25.01.2024 (zakon.uchet.kz). verify.summary: Most of the core facts hold up when re-checked against primary pages: korter's TARIH queues (A and В Q4 2026, Е and C Q1 2027, no D or F), Krisha's TARIH and DARYN data, the August 2026 General Plan points, the Айтматова history, the 2026 road list (no southern extension), route 74, the 7 bn ₸ Нура school, and the fact that the ФМЛ/РФМШ exists only in marketing ('ожидается', 'рядом будет'). These all support the user's own observation that nothing is being built beyond TARIH B. The errors are concentrated in the details. The Taldykol figures (4.5 bn ₸, 2027, 70 ha) were pinned on the wrong lake, and the 70 ha number has no source. The 'Улы дала 2' land ad was misreported: its price is not 1.0 bn (it is 1.255–1.35 bn), its 'ПДП МЖК 9-12 / 2 школы' text could not be re-verified, and its title actually ties it to the Улы Дала–Айтматова corner. Site 9 of Малый Талдыколь is overstated as preserved. The resident estimate stacks assumptions. The agent also missed three things. First, the full General Plan text is public (Resolution No. 697) and allows natural land to be taken for building with compensation. Second, the TARIH and SŪNQAR delivery dates are already slipping. Third, competing ground-floor commercial supply inside ŪIA, rather than what happens to the land south of TARIH, is the bigger issue for rent. Bottom line, from facts: nothing official commits anything to the land south or west of TARIH B, and no school, road or transit there has a funded date. ESTIMATE: a TARIH B ground-floor unit will rely only on ŪIA's own residents from 2027 onward, which is a weak case compared with DARYN units on the Улы Дала frontage.

result.notes:
FACTS
1. The user's report checks out. Korter lists only queues A, B, C and E for TARIH; there is no D or F. On Sentinel-2 of 2026-10-13, korter's TARIH pin (51.10261, 71.34896) sits on the SW corner of the built cluster, with empty steppe to the south and west. So the TARIH catchment can only face north and east (DARYN and Uly Dala). Nothing lies to the south or west.
2. Nobody lives within 1.5 km today. Every residential project there is under construction or waiting for keys. School №118 (Uly Dala 11, about 1.0 km ENE) is operating, but newtimes.kz (17.08.2026) says it sits in a 'малообжитой' area. It takes pupils turned away by other schools and moves them by organised bus, with almost no public transport.
3. Ellington Mall / Aspan is about 50% built. The mall is due end-2028 and the full quarter end-2030 (bes.media, 25.09.2026). It sits about 1.1 km NNE, north of Uly Dala, and is most likely the 'large complex under construction' seen on the imagery.
4. Apartment counts conflict between sources:
   - TARIH: korter 1,011, Krisha 337.
   - DARYN: korter 2,137, Krisha 784.
   - BIRLIK: korter and Krisha 425, against about 1,150 implied by 28 sections of 9/17 floors.
   - SŪNQAR: Krisha 112, against about 820 implied by 14 sections.
   For BI complexes the Krisha numbers look like the first queues only.
5. Delivery dates also conflict between the BI sheets and korter. Korter puts DARYN C/E/K one to two quarters later than BI. DARYN A is Q4 2027 on korter.
6. Non-BI neighbours slip repeatedly: Gasyr six times since Q4 2024, Esentai City four times, Ellington Hills three times.
7. The korter SŪNQAR pin coincides with OSM 'ЖК ŪIA.DARYN Блок B', and a Krisha ad says SŪNQAR is 'now called Daryn'. Treat SŪNQAR as possibly the same buildings as DARYN B.
8. Projects named in the task that lie outside 1.5 km: Mahabbat (1.72 km E), Uly Dala Park Life (1.94 km E), Esentai City (1.64 km NNE), Aspan Residence (about 1.9 km E), Next One (2.05 km), Baisa (2.27 km NNE) and Qadam (2.48 km NNE). Qadam and Baisa sit at the north end of Aitmatov, not near the junction.

ESTIMATES (method)
- Apartments per queue: korter totals split by residential section-floors (floors minus 1 per section), or 4 flats per floor per section where no reliable total exists.
- Share within 600 m: all of TARIH, about 70% of DARYN, nothing else. SŪNQAR and Gasyr are about 0.65–0.75 km away.
- Occupancy: 3 persons per apartment, linear from keys to 30% at 12 months, 60% at 24 and 85% at 36.
- Weakest assumptions: the SŪNQAR and BIRLIK apartment counts, the DARYN 600 m share, and on-time keys. BI dates have slipped before. A 6-month slip roughly halves the end-2027 numbers.
- Implication for a ground-floor office at TARIH B: almost no local foot traffic before mid-2027. About 600 occupied apartments within 600 m by end-2027 and about 2,000 by end-2029. The west and south sides of TARIH face empty land with no plans in place.

verify.summary:
Most of the hard data the agent cites checks out when re-fetched. Korter's TARIH figures match: 1,011 apartments, queues A/В/Е/C only, and A and В due Q4 2026. So do Gasyr's 270 apartments and its repeatedly slipping dates on kn.kz, the newtimes report on School №118 (operating, about 4,000 places, 'малообжитой' area, about 1.0 km away per OSM), and the Ellington Mall facts from bes.media (about 50% built, mall by end-2028, quarter by end-2030, ₸205.6 bn, 1.0–1.2 km NNE). I found no evidence of any school or other project south or west of TARIH B, which is consistent with what the user saw on site.

The agent's main factual conclusion, that 'nobody lives within 1.5 km / no keys handed over', is contradicted. Krisha owner ads for DARYN at Улы Дала 12/10/14 say 'дом сдан, ключи на руках' and 'КЛЮЧИ выданы, сдача июнь', and kn.kz dates those addresses Q3 2026. These blocks are about 0.6–0.65 km east of TARIH B. The SŪNQAR = DARYN overlap is likely, but the agent's stated proof (the pin on the OSM Блок B polygon) is geometrically wrong. The real support is the shared addresses Улы Дала 12/14. DARYN is 39 sections/houses on korter, not 17. The SŪNQAR (820) and BIRLIK (~1,150) apartment counts and the whole occupancy curve are assumptions without sources, so the forecast figures carry spurious precision.

The agent also missed two points: Krisha already shows the first TARIH queue slipping from Q1 2026, and the cluster already has 34 competing commercial ads, with rent asks of about 6–12k ₸/m² and rent holidays on offer. For TARIH B in particular, the fact that matters most is unchanged: the west and south sides face empty land, and the nearest residents with keys are about 600 m away to the east.

result.supply_vs_catchment:
CATCHMENT. Facts plus estimates. Korter counts: TARIH 1,011 apartments, DARYN 2,137. BIRLIK and SŪNQAR are estimated at about 1,000–1,300 and 800–1,000 (korter's 425 for BIRLIK looks incomplete, and SŪNQAR has no count). That gives about 5,000–5,500 apartments in the ÜIA cluster, about 5,500–6,000 if DARYN A at Улы Дала 12 (529 apartments) is not already in korter's figure. The user saw on site, and Sentinel-2 confirms, that there is nothing west or south of TARIH B: steppe, the wetland and the nursery. So TARIH's walk-in catchment is only the cluster itself plus, from the north, Gasyr and the school/towers across Улы Дала.

RATIO. Estimate. About 16,000–28,000 m² of ground-floor commercial space for about 5,000–5,800 apartments is about 2,800–5,500 m² per 1,000 apartments (central about 3,700). At about 3 residents per apartment that is about 0.9–1.8 m² per resident.

BENCHMARK. Our rule of thumb, not a sourced statistic. Neighbourhood-level demand for everyday retail and services (grocery, pharmacy, salons, kids' clubs, small clinics, cafés) is commonly about 1,000–2,000 m² per 1,000 apartments. Planning norms put shop sales area alone at a few hundred m² per 1,000 residents. On that basis the cluster's planned ground-floor space is roughly 2–3x what the residents alone can absorb. Astana's own new-build districts typically show the same pattern: almost every first floor on a street or alley is commercial, so oversupply in a new district is normal and vacancy is high for the first 1–3 years. I found no published Astana figure on m² per 1,000 apartments, so this comparison is a qualitative judgement.

TIMING. On 2026-10-14 almost nobody lives there yet. Only DARYN A at Улы Дала 12 has keys, and SŪNQAR is due Q3 2026. Meanwhile about 70 BI units are on sale, 12 owner units are offered for rent, and none of the 12 ÜIA rent ads mentions an existing tenant. Several offer rent holidays ('каникулы'). Our conclusion: oversupplied for at least 2026–2027. TARIH units on the inner alley compete against DARYN and Gasyr units that front Улы Дала at similar or lower asks (5,700–10,800 ₸/m²).

commentary.claim: Colliers International (Shakhida Sadyrova), on Almaty: residential-retail supply formed over two years is about 117k m², and at least one third of it is vacant. Average rent is 4.7k ₸/m² (from 2.5k). Low occupancy is mostly because developers prefer to sell premises rather than lease them. Anchor and chain tenants are not expected. Courtyard-facing units serve only local demand, and first-line units with pedestrian or transport flow get the highest rents.

Colliers Kazakhstan (Maxim Nikityuk): street retail remains the most liquid commercial segment, because the ticket is low and the buyer pool wide. Commercial property targets about a 10-year payback, and developers aim for a cap rate of about 10%. Street retail on a busy through-street with developed infrastructure gives higher yield at lower risk.

Colliers Kazakhstan (Danila Petrov): online retail grew from 482 bn to 3.77 trn ₸ in 2021-2025, from 3.6% to 13.6% of retail, and marketplaces took about 86% of online sales in 2025. Astana mall occupancy was about 92% in Q1 2026. Medical and coworking uses are 'точечные решения' that depend on location, parking and entrance.

Capital Realty: there are no official street-retail rent statistics for Astana. Astana commissioned 4.81 M m² of housing in 2025, which means strong competition for tenants on the ground floors of new complexes. Finding a tenant for a narrow format 'может занять месяцы'. In their example, 2 empty months a year cut the yield by about 1.7 pp (8.4% to 6.7%). The simplified-regime tax for an individual entrepreneur in Astana is 3% from 2026.

My computation on a krisha.kz Astana snapshot (13-14.10.2026, about 1,239 residential ground-floor cards with full text): rent holidays ('каникулы') appear in 24% of 2025-built and 22% of 2026-built rent cards. The share is 11% for 2022-2024 builds and 2-5% for pre-2022 builds. A tenant in place is mentioned in only 2-4% of 2025-2026-built sale cards, against 9-15% for older stock.

My computation on the same snapshot, residential ground floors 5-8 km from the centre (ÜIA's band). New-build asks run about 30% above those of buildings 2-4 years old in the same ring. Part of the gap is quality, and part is initial asking optimism that is later cut.

Typical first tenants in delivered new-build clusters, from krisha cards. A blog post (not verified) says Ozon's Kazakhstan pick-up network grew 27x in a year to more than 1,300 points.

Russian-market reference, not Kazakhstan: first floors in new residential complexes often stand empty, with vacancy reaching up to 30% in the first years. Supply often does not match retailer needs (for example, a supermarket needs 400-2,000 m² without load-bearing walls).

ramp.rationale:
FACTS behind it:
(1) ÜIA's own pre-delivery asks have a median of 9,865 ₸/m² (n=9).
(2) Delivered analogs ask less. Athletic City, 2-3.5 years after keys: 8,344 (n=8). Jetisu: 8,246 (n=28); Kerbez 1-2 years after keys about 8,680. Salman City, about 16 months after keys, true frontier: 7,119 (n=16). Turan Palace, 1.5-3 years: 6,854 (n=3). OİU, delivering now: 6,640 asks (n=4).
(3) In ÜIA's 5-8 km ring, 2022-2024 builds ask 5,556 against 8,206 for 2025+ builds.
(4) Concessions are common in young stock. 22-24% of 2025-2026-built rent cards offer каникулы, typically 'на ремонт' or 3 months. One Athletic City ask was cut 22%. Salman City has a 2,445 ₸/m² ask with 3 months free.
(5) Early tenants do appear. Jetisu Nauryz has a 41 m² unit let at 8,537 ₸/m² within about 7 months of keys. OİU has a corner unit at the entrance pre-let to a minimarket at 9,028 ₸/m² before delivery. Salman City has a grocery tenant within about a year.
(6) Listed stock is large. Salman City has about 22 premises for rent or sale about 16 months after keys, and Athletic City about 12 at 2-3.5 years.

ESTIMATES:
- Mature rent (M) for ÜIA ground floors: 8,500-9,000 ₸/m²/month asking, which is about 0.85-0.9 of today's ÜIA asks. This is anchored on Athletic City, Jetisu Kerbez and Äuez/Family BI medians of 9,100-10,000.
- Year 1 (contracted rate): 75% of M, about 6,400-6,750 ₸/m². Salman City, Turan Palace and OİU asks of 6,600-7,100 are consistent with this, and deals usually close below asks.
- Year 2: 88%. Year 3: 95%, as DARYN, SŪNQAR and BIRLIK fill (keys 2026-2027) and residents finish their renovations.
- Year 1 vacancy: 7 months, made up of about 4-5 months unlet plus about 2-3 months rent-free.
- Expected economic vacancy: about 15% in year 2 (about 2 months) and 8-10% from year 3 (about 1 month a year).
- Because the land beyond TARIH B is empty, B's outer façades (Айтматова line, southern street) carry no passing traffic until those streets and the ФМЛ are built. Demand in years 1-2 is only from ÜIA residents. That is why year 1 is set below the Jetisu queues, which were delivered next to populated earlier phases.
ramp.range_note:
Uncertainty (estimates):
- Months to first tenant: 3 (corner, minimarket or pharmacy, pre-let as at OİU) to 18 (inner-courtyard unit, empty frontage, many competing ÜIA units released at once).
- Year 1 rent: 55-85% of M. Year 2: 75-95%. Year 3: 85-100%.
- Year 1 vacancy: 3-12 months. Downside: the Salman City pattern of about half the stock listed 16 months after keys, plus 2,400-4,600 ₸/m² distress asks. Upside: a pre-let or chain tenant at 9,000+ ₸/m² from month 1-3.
- M itself is ±10% (8,000-9,800).
- Data limits: all rents are krisha asks, not deals. Older (1-3 year) krisha snapshots were not retrievable (archive.org blocked, old cards return 403), so the ramp comes from comparing vintages in today's snapshot, not from tracking the same units over time. Unit counts per complex are estimates.

verify.summary:
I re-fetched the krisha map polygons, listing cards, korter pages and press articles on 14.10.2026. Headline counts and medians mostly reproduce: Athletic City 23 rent listings, Salman City 14 rent listings with median 7,202, Turan Palace 3 listings at 4,000/6,854/7,225, Kerbez Comfort about 8,050, Abadan with no listings. The Colliers and Capital Realty quotes are accurate, though the Colliers vacancy figure is Almaty 2020.

The weak points are the claims the ramp leans on most:
- **OİU pre-let:** the minimarket tenant is seller text, contradicted by the card's own 'no tenants' field, and OİU is still under construction.
- **Athletic City as the mature anchor:** it mixes vintages (2021–2026 builds by krisha), and the 'mature' median includes a basement unit and subleases.
- **22% ask cut:** this could not be reproduced.
